name: jay-claude-plugins
description: Monorepo for Claude Code plugins: pixijs and web-craft.

scripts.validate: claude plugin validate . --strict && claude plugin validate plugins/pixijs --strict && claude plugin validate plugins/web-craft --strict
scripts.publish:dry: npm publish --workspace pixijs-claude-plugin --dry-run && npm publish --workspace web-craft-claude-plugin --dry-run
scripts.publish:all: npm publish --workspace pixijs-claude-plugin --access public && npm publish --workspace web-craft-claude-plugin --access public
scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run refs:check
